questions.question: In the context of Synthetic Polymers, what is the major organic product when Styrene (PhCH=CH₂) reacts under the following conditions: Benzoyl peroxide (BPO) at 80°C in toluene?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Peroxide initiator generates benzyl-stabilized propagating radicals that add sequentially to styrene double bonds. The correct major product is 'Polystyrene [-(CH(Ph)-CH₂)-ₙ]'.

questions.question: In the context of Synthetic Polymers, what is the major organic product when 2-Methylpropene (Isobutylene) reacts under the following conditions: BF₃ / H₂O (catalytic) at -80°C?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Protonation forms a stable tertiary carbocation that rapidly propagates by adding successive isobutylene monomers. The correct major product is 'Polyisobutylene [-(C(CH₃)₂-CH₂)-ₙ] (Butyl rubber)'.

questions.question: In the context of Synthetic Polymers, what is the major organic product when Methyl methacrylate [CH₂=C(CH₃)COOCH₃] reacts under the following conditions: n-Butyllithium (BuLi) in THF at -78°C?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Nucleophilic attack of carbanion initiator forms an ester-stabilized enolate anion propagating chain. The correct major product is 'Poly(methyl methacrylate) [PMMA / Plexiglas]'.

questions.question: In the context of Synthetic Polymers, what is the major organic product when Propene (CH₃-CH=CH₂) reacts under the following conditions: TiCl₄ / Al(CH₂CH₃)₃ heterogeneous catalyst?

options.label: C

questions.correct_answer: Isotactic Polypropylene (All methyl groups on same face)

questions.question: In the context of Synthetic Polymers, what is the major organic product when Hexanedioic acid (Adipic acid) + 1,6-Diaminohexane reacts under the following conditions: Heat (280°C, continuous -H₂O removal)?
